en.headline: Hong Kong Asian Games athletes greet residents in Sha Tin bus parade
en.dek: Gold medallists in rowing and windsurfing joined teammates for an open-top bus tour organised with the Sha Tin Festival.
body: Hong Kong athletes who competed at the Nagoya Asian Games took part in an open-top bus parade through Sha Tin on Tuesday afternoon.

The event, jointly organised by the Sha Tin Festival Committee and the Sha Tin District Home Affairs Office, began with a kick-off ceremony at Sha Tin Town Hall Square. Participants included rowing gold medallist Chiu Hin-chun, windsurfing gold medallist Wong Tsz-ho, and several silver and bronze medallists.

Chiu said he and his coach had set a goal of winning gold after taking bronze at the previous Games, and he was pleased the preparation had paid off. Wong described taking a year off studies for full-time training and called the gold medal a perfect end to the journey.
The parade route passed outside Tai Wai MTR station, Kingswood Plaza in Shek Mun and Chung On Shopping Centre. Organisers also distributed commemorative souvenirs to the public.

zh.headline: 亞運港隊運動員沙田開蓬巴士巡遊與居民見面
zh.dek: 賽艇及滑浪風帆金牌得主聯同其他獎牌得主，參與沙田節委員會與民政處合辦的巡遊活動。
body: 出戰名古屋亞運後返港的中國香港運動員，周二下午在沙田區舉行開蓬巴士巡遊。
活動由沙田節委員會與沙田民政處合辦，先在沙田大會堂廣場舉行啟動儀式。出席者包括賽艇金牌趙顯臻、滑浪風帆金牌黃梓豪，以及多名銀牌及銅牌得主。
趙顯臻表示，上屆杭州亞運取得銅牌後與教練訂立計劃，希望今屆奪金，經過數年準備終獲成功。黃梓豪則稱過去一年休學全職訓練，金牌為旅程劃上完美句號。
巡遊途經大圍港鐵站外、石門京瑞廣場及頌安商場。主辦單位亦向市民派發紀念品。
